title: yoshida card review (format 1)
description: Written by the editor. The command line does not read it. An approval stays valid while the card and the design inputs hash to the same value. Format 1 files (one note per card) are read and rewritten as format 2.

format.description: The editor writes 2. Format 1 has a single "note" per card instead of "comments".

cards.description: Reviews by card file path, then by card id. A card without an entry is unreviewed.

status.description: The mark. Without one the card is unreviewed; open comments make it count as needing changes.

hash.description: Hash of the card's values (and its id when the design reads card.id) and the design inputs (the design file and the components it includes) when it was reviewed. A different hash turns an approval into 'changed since review'.

at.description: When the mark was set (UTC, to the minute).

note.description: Format 1 only: read as the first comment.

comments.description: Points to address on the card. A card with an open (not resolved) comment counts as needing changes.

x.description: Pin position on the card in canvas pixels; needs y.
